claim: The streaming gate cannot report PASS on impossible numbers
evidence: First run reported 1863 GB touched from a 10.36 GB file and 2.8e12 elements, and printed PASS. Three defects fixed: per-tensor counters never reset in open(); setWindow called before blockElems was known so the window collapsed to 1 block; gate only tested 'decoded something'. Gate now also requires touchedBytes<=fileBytes, elements<=declaredElements, elements==declaredElements, window>0.
